item.title: Queen's Distance Track bringing small but competitive team to U SPORTS Track & Field Championship
item.description: Queen's Distance Track will send a small, but very competitive team into this year's U SPORTS Track & Field Championships in Winnipeg, Man. this week. The Gaels will send Elizabeth Vroom, Jude Wheeler-Dee, and Tanner Hueglin to the national championship, with all three competitors having a legitimate chance to medal in their respective events in what is expected to be some of the greatest races ever run at the U SPORTS level.

item.title: Get your tickets to Forsyth Cup and support Queen's Men's Volleyball as they compete for OUA Championship in Windsor
item.description: Queen's Men's Volleyball is competing for the Forsyth Cup in Windsor, Ont. on Friday and the Gaels want your support in the OUA Championship Game!

item.title: Queen's Women's Volleyball's Claire Carter, Lauren MacPhail, Abbey McAlpine named OUA All-Stars
item.description: Queen's Women's Volleyball had three players named OUA All-Stars for the 2025-26 season, the conference announced on Wednesday. Claire Carter was named a First Team All-Star, Lauren MacPhail was named a Second Team All-Star, and Abbey McAlpine was named a Third Team All-Star for the 2025-26.

item.title: Queen's Women's Basketball's Kiyara Letlow named U SPORTS Second Team All-Canadian
item.description: Queen's Women's Basketball's Kiyara Letlow was named a U SPORTS Second Team All-Canadian at the U SPORTS All-Canadian Awards banquet in Quebec City, Que. on Wednesday.

item.title: Queen's Women's Basketball's Bella Gaudet named U SPORTS Women's Basketball's Tracy McLeod Award recipient
item.description: Queen's Women's Basketball's Bella Gaudet has been named the U SPORTS Women's Basketball's Tracy McLeod Award recipient for the 2025-26 season at the U SPORTS Women's Basketball All-Canadian Awards banquet on Wednesday. The Tracy McLeod Award recognizes perseverence, determination, and unwavering dedication to the game.

item.title: Hutcheson’s Late Winner Lifts Gaels to 5–3 Victory in East Final Opener.
item.description: Queen's opens their East Final series at the Memorial Centre in front of a packed crowd of Gaels fans, looking to capitalize on their only home game of the series and grab a crucial win before the battle shifts to Quebec.

item.title: Queen's Men's Volleyball's Reed Venning, Nikola Mitrovic, Carson Francis named OUA All-Stars
item.description: Queen's Men's Volleyball had three student-athletes recognized as OUA All-Stars for the 2025-26 season, the conference announced on Thursday. Reed Venning was named a First Team All-Star, Nikola Mitrovic was named a Second Team All-Star, and Carson Francis was named to the conference's All-Rookie Team.

item.title: Queen's Men's Volleyball's Chris Zimmerman awarded Champion of EDI Award by OUA
item.description: Queen's Men's Volleyball's Chris Zimmerman was named the OUA Champion of EDI Award recipient by the conference on Thursday.
